purpose: Three distinct underground mining environment concepts with new terrain palettes and material shapes, keeping the original protagonist's identity.
method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, one distinct concept per call.
methodReason: Large painted environment exploration with character references; not low-resolution tile or collision-mask production.
nativeDimensions: Record actual PNG size after generation; no resizing.
shapeAccuracy: Natural supported side-view terrain and visible surface thickness; not exact authority/collision geometry.

generationInputs.role: Authoritative original character silhouette, proportions, colors and face.
Original hand-drawn cyan head and gray segmented collar component.
Environment drawing style and depth hierarchy only; do not inherit its ochre/gray palette or boulder pattern.

outputs.direction: Terracotta and dusty cream sedimentary rock with broad horizontal strata.
Muted sage and deep pine slate with oblique split plates.
Moon-white salt rock with dusty lilac cavities and rounded eroded masses.

characterInvariants: Oversized cyan rounded hood and very small cyan torso and limbs.
Warm beige face opening, short angled eyebrows, upright dark eyes and a broad angular V mouth.
Original gray segmented neck rim, imperfect black contours, flat colors.
No visor glass, helmet redesign, backpack, headlamp, gloves or boots.
animationBoundary: Static visual targets. Plants, waterfall/water and transient effects require independent production layers.
productionBoundary: No Game, Spine source, YYGC, gameplay, tile atlas, WFC or Unity changes.
